robot_id.description: The robot a record of a `per_robot` or `one_per_robot` collection belongs to; null in a `global` collection.

kind.description: What made the change: a developer, a user of the app, a server key of the app, or the platform itself.

id.description: The id of the developer, app user or server key. The nil id for the platform.

label.description: A name to show: the person's display name, the name of a server key, `Fleetless`, `Deleted user` when the user no longer exists, or `Deleted key` when the key does. A person without a display name reads as their email address to a developer or a server key and to themselves, and to an app user reading someone else as `Team member` (a developer) or `User` (an app user): an app user never learns another person's address.

created_by.description: Who or what made a change to a record.

kind.description: What made the change: a developer, a user of the app, a server key of the app, or the platform itself.

id.description: The id of the developer, app user or server key. The nil id for the platform.

updated_by.description: Who or what made a change to a record.

revision.description: Starts at 1 and grows by one with every change. Send it as `expected_revision` to refuse a write that would overwrite a newer one.

display.description: The collection's display template filled in for this record.

missing_required.description: Required fields that are empty because the schema changed after the record was written. The record can still be updated in its other fields. Absent when nothing is missing.

values.description: The record's fields by key. A field without a value is absent. With `expand`, a reference field holds the referenced record in this same shape instead of its id, when the caller may read that collection.

deleted_at.description: When the record was deleted. Present only in the list of deleted records (`deleted=true`); absent on a live record.
